tool_args.value: Hires profiles (concentration=0.5749, from llama_hires_bf16_2bitonly_profiles.json) merged with standard 4/8-bit profiles. Constrained MCKP (max_2bit=2, budget=0.25, L0-excluded) selected 2 heads for 2-bit: (26,0), (31,7); 1 head for 8-bit: (12,3); rest at 4-bit. WikiText-2 PPL results: BF16=8.0922, Hires-MCKP=8.5042, Uniform-4bit=8.4701, Std-MCKP-ref=8.4498. KEY FINDINGS: (1) Hires MCKP UNDERPERFORMS uniform 4-bit by 0.0341 (-9%), verdict=FAIL. With standard profiles, MCKP beat uniform by +0.2% — hires inverts the sign. The hires-selected 2-bit heads ((26,0), (31,7)) are worse choices than standard MCKP would pick. (2) Hires-MCKP PPL 8.5042 vs Table-1 standard 8.4498: diff=0.0544 < seed variance 0.065 → Table 1 PPL value NOT strictly out-of-spec, but very close to the threshold (within ~84% of variance). Recommend keeping Table 1 at 8.45 with a footnote noting hires profiling produces a worse MCKP allocation on Llama; this is consistent with the paper's claim that standard profiling is sufficient. (3) Uniform-4bit identical across runs (8.4701 vs std 8.469, diff=0.001) — confirms eval pipeline stability. Bit distribution exactly matches budget: 253×4bit + 2×2bit + 1×8bit = 0.25 memory ratio.
